scope: 确立 Web 应用部署规范与运行边界。Service Worker 与高级安全 API 仅支持在 HTTPS 或 localhost 本地安全上下文中运行，file:// 协议不支持注册 Service Worker，首版不可承诺脱机离线冷重启。
content: Documents are secure contexts when their resources are delivered over an HTTPS connection, or are delivered from a loopback (local) address... Service workers and worklets: Only secure contexts are allowed to register service workers, so service workers are always secure contexts... Potentially trustworthy origins: An origin is potentially trustworthy if has: A scheme of https, wss, or file. A host value of 127.0.0.0/8 or ::1/128, localhost.
